row:
Md Habibur Rahman is the Founder and Chief Practitioner of Pain Care Chiropractic Centre, a trusted Chiropractic, Osteopathy, and Pain Management centre in Bangladesh.

He holds DSc & MCSc (Chiropractic Science) from Palms Chiropractic College (Japan), Diploma in Osteopath, Osteopathic College of Ontario (Canada), Fellow in Osteopath from SBS University (India) and Ideal Health Care (Australia). He is also a Member of the Pan-Asian Society of Full Spine Chiropractic Professionals (PASFSCP), Japan.

Provide advanced non-surgical care for low back pain, neck pain, sciatica, scoliosis, disc prolapse (PLID/PIVD), slipped disc, spondylolisthesis, arthritis, body misalignment, and sports injuries.

📍 Dhaka, Bangladesh
📞 09638-334466 | 01888-113331
